methodology.constructionWatch: A research queue combining reviewed physical-stage evidence with mature official plans that still require field verification. A verification priority is never a construction claim.
methodology.screening: A transparent planning-backed prioritization of official AGRO polygons. It ranks research readiness, not engineering, agronomic, legal or commercial suitability.
excludedFromSuitability: grid hosting capacity and connection cost
soil, crop, microclimate and irrigation fit
military, aviation and other statutory restrictions
